name: BACH_0006
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (85%)** · Confident · Read in turn

Single-class conformal set, second model agrees, all five similar cases Normal [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 85%, InSitu 14%, Benign 1%, Invasive 0% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Normal} | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 78th percentile | Typical input, unflagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Neighbors all match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 4, 6, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term, but regions failed spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above typical, yet invasive probability is 0% [F3] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 6, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; fits non-invasive tissue [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Scored low despite 14% InSitu probability · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI spans 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); unproven. Normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 8, 9, 11 hold early invasion that the model scores near 0%.
- Region 1's 14% InSitu share is real; too few tumor nuclei were segmented to check.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 1**: highest per-region invasive risk (16%); look for atypical cells confined in ducts.
2. **Regions 8, 9, 11**: decide whether the infiltrating-stroma signal is invasion or reactive stroma.
3. **Regions 4, 6, 11**: confirm two-layered lobular epithelium directly; its concept failed spot check.
